Links: SPY · AAPL · TSLA · XOM · NOW · DELL · PLTR · Watchlist · Options Playbook · Fed Tracker · Federal Reserve

The one thing that matters most

SPY 758.74 — the 50% retracement of the Jul 31 → Oct 6 swing — is the line for the week. SPY closed at 759.97 (Fri low 758.68), below its 20-day (770.15) and 50-day (766.90), above its 200-day (724.00). The test runs into the Federal Reserve decision Wed 2:00 pm ET (hold ~90.6% priced, range 3.75–4.00%), Alphabet + Microsoft Wed night, then Amazon + Q3 GDP + Sep PCE Thu. 10-yr 5.00%, WTI $103.27, Brent $116.72, VIX 19.45. SPX 7,623.68 (−0.5% wk, 2nd weekly loss).
